Subject: Deployment residency & mode follow-up

Hi Oliver,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — great to learn more about FinBank's fraud detection rollout and the residency constraints you have for EU customers. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- What we heard: primary requirement is EU data residency for production traffic and audit evidence that logs/PII do not leave the EU. Secondary: HA/failover behavior across regions and an ops-friendly pilot.
- Deployment modes we discussed: Hosted API (preferred for fast time-to-value), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools in-region) and Private VPC/on-prem (for stricter controls).

Attachments: Redwood-region-matrix.pdf (regions & latency SLOs) and SOC2-summary.pdf that covers our controls.

Can you confirm these priorities? Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll loop in Aditya (Solutions Eng) to confirm technical behavior for in-region processing and cross-region routing.
2) If Hosted in EU meets your residency needs, we can propose a 4-week pilot plan. If not, we’ll outline Dedicated and Private timelines and cost ballparks.
3) Please share any specific SSO/KMS or procurement constraints so we can include them in the proposal.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a technical workshop once Aditya confirms availability.

Best,

Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the summary — that captures it. A few clarifications from my side:

- Residency: We need to be able to demonstrate that production request/response data and operational logs for EU customers remain within the EU (no mandatory cross-border replication). Backups can be stored outside EU only if encrypted and under contractual controls, but our preference is EU-only.
- Failover: We want automated failover only if it can be restricted to EU regions; otherwise we need to control where traffic fails over.
- Timeline & cost: Hosted (EU) sounds ideal from speed/cost perspective — can you provide a ballpark monthly cost for a pilot handling ~2M tokens/day and expected latency percentiles? If Hosted can't meet residency with contractual guarantees, we will consider Dedicated or Private.

If Aditya can confirm the in-region processing guarantees and whether logs/metrics are retained regionally, that would help.

Oliver Svensson
Head of Platform, FinBank
oliver.svensson@finbank.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.example.com>

Hi Oliver / Marissa,

Quick technical follow-up from the discovery — summary below is accurate to our current platform capabilities and options.

Hosted API (EU):
- Regions: We currently offer hosted endpoints in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) and eu-west-1 (Ireland).
- Processing: Production request/response processing occurs in-region. We do not route active inference traffic outside the chosen region.
- Logs & metrics: Operational logs (request traces, delivery metrics) are retained in-region by default for Hosted EU; cross-region replication is an opt-in feature and can be disabled in your tenancy.
- Backups: Snapshot/backup policies can be configured to retain data in-region only; where customers require it, we can add contractual guarantees for EU-only storage.
- Failover/Cross-region routing: We support policy-based routing. By default we can limit automated failover to other EU regions only. If you want to avoid any cross-border failover, we can lock failover to a single region and add manual failover procedures.

Dedicated (reserved capacity in EU):
- Availability: We can provision Dedicated capacity in EU regions. Lead time for provisioning reserved GPU pools is typically 4–6 weeks depending on capacity and instance types.
- Isolation: Dedicated ensures tenant isolation and predictable throughput; logs/metrics remain in-region.

Private (VPC / on-prem):
- Support: We support Private deployments for customers requiring full network isolation. Timeline is longer (8–12 weeks typical) because of onboarding, KMS/HSM integration, and networking.

Costs / pilot sizing (ballpark):
- Hosted EU pilot for ~2M tokens/day: estimate $8k–$12k/month (depends on generation vs embeddings mix and batching).
- Dedicated reserve: higher up-front commit; expect 2–3x Hosted unit cost for reserved predictable throughput.
- Private: pricing varies with infra and support — typically custom quoted.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Technical workshop to validate SSO/KMS and dataflow diagrams (30–45m).
2) Share any procurement/contract constraints (e.g., need for EU-only contractual clause).
3) If Hosted EU is acceptable, we can spin up a pilot within ~1 week and provide canary routing options to limit traffic to EU.

Related artifacts: deployment-runbook.md (attached) and the region matrix Marissa shared. Happy to jump on a call this week.

Cheers,

Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

2) We'd like to run a 4-week Hosted EU pilot with canary traffic limited to EU customers only. Please provide the onboarding checklist and estimated start date.

Oliver
